content.json:
## Tenant Manager service levels
SLOs (docs/operations.md): **99% of API requests under 500 ms** and **99.5% of API requests succeed** (not 5xx), each over 30 days. Health probes are excluded.

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp > ago(30d) and name !startswith "GET /health"
| summarize Requests = count(), UnderLatency = round(100.0 * countif(duration < 500) / count(), 3), Succeeded = round(100.0 * countif(toint(resultCode) < 500) / count(), 3)
| extend LatencySlo = iff(UnderLatency >= 99, "met", "MISSED"), AvailabilitySlo = iff(Succeeded >= 99.5, "met", "MISSED")
content.title: 30-day SLO compliance (%)

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp > ago(24h) and name !startswith "GET /health"
| summarize p50 = percentile(duration, 50), p95 = percentile(duration, 95), p99 = percentile(duration, 99) by bin(timestamp, 15m)
| render timechart
content.title: Latency, last 24 hours (ms)

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp > ago(24h) and name !startswith "GET /health"
| summarize Requests = count(), ServerErrors = countif(toint(resultCode) >= 500) by bin(timestamp, 15m)
| render timechart
content.title: Requests and server errors, last 24 hours

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp > ago(7d) and name !startswith "GET /health"
| summarize Requests = count(), p95 = percentile(duration, 95), Errors = countif(toint(resultCode) >= 500) by name
| top 15 by p95 desc
content.title: Slowest endpoints, last 7 days

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp > ago(7d) and name startswith "tm."
| summarize Total = sum(valueSum) by name, bin(timestamp, 1d)
| render columnchart
content.title: Business events per day (payments verified, issues, WhatsApp messages, rejected webhooks)
